# Temple Scroll Column 6 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 6 | **Condition:** Heavily damaged to fragmentary; Festival of New Wine

---

**6:1** [...] after [the-Festival of-Weeks ...] you-shall-count [...]

**6:2** [...] from-the-day you-brought the-new grain-offering [...]

**6:3** [...] seven weeks [...] seven complete [sabbaths ...]

**6:4** [...] until the-morrow of-the-seventh sabbath you-shall-count [...]

**6:5** [...] fifty days [...]

**6:6** [...] and-you-shall-bring new wine for-a-drink-offering [...]

**6:7** [...] new wine [...] you-shall-offer [...]

**6:8** [...] a-drink-offering of-new-wine upon the-altar [...]

**6:9** [...] and-the-priests shall-offer first [...] the-Levites [...] and-then the-sons-of-Israel [...]

**6:10** [...] and-you-shall-rejoice before the-LORD your-God [...]

**6:11** [...] a-statute of-eternity for-your-generations in-all your-dwelling-places [...]

---

*EMET notes: Column 6 introduces the Festival of New Wine (chag ha-tirosh), a celebration unique to the Temple Scroll's expanded festival calendar with no direct Pentateuchal parallel. It falls fifty days after the Festival of Weeks (hence 100 days after Passover). The new wine is offered as a drink offering. The tripartite order — priests first, then Levites, then all Israel — reflects the scroll's hierarchical liturgical order.*
